about_the_game:
Dive into a new world filled with intriguing and sexy girls in Streaming for Love. 

Engage in romantic escapades with coworkers and take your time to meet new people. Explore an exciting universe with hot streamers, make new friends, and live life to the fullest! 

Experience unexpected romances and spontaneous encounters with fascinating women, all while unraveling mysteries and getting swept up in thrilling plots you never saw coming.

Welcome to “Streaming for Love,” where you step into the shoes of a young, charming broker in the vibrant city of Sallesport. Amidst the towering skyscrapers and bustling business scenes, you’re climbing the corporate ladder at SouthWind Investments, making money and navigating the fast-paced world of finance.

But beneath the surface, a growing emptiness gnaws at you. Casual encounters no longer fill the void in your routine. Is something essential missing from your life?

The plot thickens when you discover a deeper connection with Chloe, a coworker who ignites a spark in your heart. Just as you start to explore this unexpected romance, life takes an intriguing twist. Theo, another colleague, introduces you to the fascinating world of streamers.

Meet Sophia, a captivating content creator who draws you in with her gaming skills and charming humor. She’s not just another pretty face; her wit and authenticity set her apart. A contest victory brings your worlds together, leading to a life-changing encounter.

Now, you’re torn between two incredible women, each offering a unique path to love. But romance is just the beginning. Your life becomes a thrilling rollercoaster ride filled with hackers, theft attempts, eccentric businessmen, and competitive streamers.

As you navigate these challenges, unexpected friendships and cunning alliances form, adding layers of mystery and suspense to your journey. Will you find true love amidst the chaos? Join us in "Streaming for Love," a gripping release from Love-Joint, packed with captivating characters, interactive minigames, and unforgettable moments. Dive into this adventure and live out your wildest dreams.

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes violence, drugs and sexual content. All characters are purely fictional and over the age of 18. All sex scenes in the game are fully consensual.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Monterey or Newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4400 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU. Intel i3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4400 or better (with up-to-date drivers)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
